authority_invariant: Capability may change. Authority does not.

SIGNAL.change: Cross-domain intent is proposal-only; downstream controller authorizes; simulation evidence before any live physical integration.

PRIMER.reason: No evidence supports wider learner profiling, retention, diagnosis, or action authority.

Sentinel_v3.change: Ed25519/SHA3 artifact provenance; pre-runtime component admission; consent gate; authority-service scoped single-use credentials; simulation gate; Ed25519/SHA3 receipt chain.

AnnealMesh.change: Require maturity, availability horizon, evidence, benchmark, comparator, independent verification and verified_advantage; IonQ remains research evidence; Decart talks do not promote a backend.

BriefOps.change: Five dated items, source links, dispositions, test output and SHA3 file hashes; distinguish reports from confirmed events.

no_change: destructive, physical, financial, health-write, and unauthenticated alert effects
